scope: Native CLI text export of the accepted K02.var01 named Station SXI with explicit exclamation delimiter and 4096-character page width, alongside JSON export of the same copied SXI for comparison.

manual.observed_rule: Text export uses all input tables, -tsep selects one of the valid delimiters, and -twidth bounds page width. The printed CLI table has a -treport/-texport inconsistency; the -tsep/-twidth rows and command example name -texport.

acceptance_hypotheses: The documented -texport command creates a nonempty text file with table markers, column headings and authored rows of the copied K02 model.
The native text format records all row-containing business tables from same-run JSON export without truncating the last columns at width 4096; station BASE-01 and K02-NAMED remain identifiable.
The copied SXI bytes remain identical to the accepted parent; guarded CLI steps preserve the protected GUI and are individually logged.
gate: Any missing text output, omitted business table, missing authored row, truncated heading/row or changed source SXI is NO-GO. Exact numerical precision is observed and reported rather than presumed lossless because the manual cautions text transfer may lose accuracy.
limitations: One installed-engine CLI text export does not establish text reimport, clipboard, Excel XML, GUI formatting options, all precision cases or full K03 completion.
